result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk on the side street but no visible crossing infrastructure across the main road. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the lack of traffic control and wide turning radii may encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.

result.summary: The environment is a residential intersection with a wide main road featuring a painted median buffer but no marked pedestrian crossings across it. While a crosswalk exists for the side street, the lack of continuous sidewalks and crossing infrastructure on the primary thoroughfare creates significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalk across the wide main road, leaving pedestrians unprotected when crossing the primary thoroughfare.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Missing sidewalk

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the corner lot may block visibility between drivers on the main road and pedestrians on the side street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility zebra crosswalk across the main road to designate a safe crossing point and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Extension
interventions.description: Construct a sidewalk on the right side of the main road to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Utilize the existing wide painted median to install a raised refuge island, reducing crossing distance and exposure time.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, sightlines are partially obstructed by corner vegetation, and there is a lack of visible traffic control or signage for the crossing.

hazards.description: Large bushes on the corner lot may block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate traffic at this marked crossing.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove corner vegetation to ensure clear sightlines between all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk with curb ramps. However, the wide corner radius and lack of visible traffic control devices at the crossing point may encourage higher vehicle speeds and reduce pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Wide Corner Radius
hazards.description: The large radius of the curb at the intersection allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground corner where the sidewalk curves

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow at the marked pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the corner radius.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a raised crosswalk to act as a speed table, forcing vehicles to slow down while increasing pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Ensure no parking is allowed within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to maintain clear sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
